Its claims fit the cache posture in T-041 (encrypted SSD cache, HMAC-keyed names, 30-minute TTL, SEC-035 accepted) and the logout/custody notes on A-008. The new env var is a performance or kernel-selection switch for prompt prefill. It appears to be a local operator knob with no stated link to cache scoping, key handling or trust gates. The actual Swift kernel change is not in this batch, so I could not check whether it alters numerics or timing. Possible TTFT-oracle effects (T-041) on same-account probing are speculative and unsupported by evidence here. Integration should check whether the matching code PR changes the prefill kernel or TTFT characteristics, and whether the variable is forwarded into launchd. Neither can be verified from this doc-only unit.
